title: Sherbrooke-Water-Hunter corridor recording appearance review
sourceCalibration: Existing experimental FisheyeReframer calibration; visual reference only, not surveyed measurements.

summary.appearanceScope: Facade/garden appearance fields only; footprints, endpoints, heights, roofs, identity and collision remain unchanged.
summary.baselineReview: All 55 full frontage baseline captures were reviewed in five contact sheets. Five supported appearance additions were integrated and recaptured; R16 and R19 arch proposals were rejected after source-to-building review. Final comparison and performance evidence are in test-artifacts/recording-complete-20261025.
